svg.text: PRL lathe | 6061-T6 | mm | REV C / 2026-11-05 | engineering review before cutting
1. Datum A = rear flange z=0; datum B = bore axis. Coordinates are local CAD mm.
2. Overall z=0..54; flange OD58 ±0.10 x 6 ±0.05; body OD40 ±0.05.
3. Chamber Ø32 +0.05/0 from z19..47; rear throat Ø27 ±0.10 from z0..19.
4. Seat pocket Ø34.05 +0.03/0 from z47..54; seat slip fit clearance 0.05 nominal.
5. 4 x Ø3.4 THRU flange on PCD50 at 0/90/180/270deg. M3 tie screws.
6. Front body ends at z54. Face insert begins there; do not extend body to z60.
7. Rear O-ring face land annulus r13.5..20; RMS ≤0.8 µm; face flatness0.03.
8. Retainer uses3 axialM3 screws into printed sleeve; no screw hole penetrates wet body.
GENERAL: unspecified linear ±0.10; angles ±0.5°; remove burrs. Fits/seals follow tighter callouts above.
Blue/gray view lines are CAD geometry; hidden edges dashed. Do not scale image. Thread helices omitted.
